title: Hivewise seed pitch (fictional)
speaker: Narrator
pace: a live pitch: brisk, upbeat and natural, controlled nerves, confident never arrogant

pronounce.Varroa: say 'Varroa' as vuh-ROH-uh, the Latin name of the mite

lines.text: Every spring, beekeepers lift a lid... and find a silent hive.
lines.style: deep voice, a quick breath in, then bright and vivid like opening a story on stage, a small hush on 'silent hive'

lines.text: We think that hive was telling them for weeks.
lines.style: leaning in, warm and certain, energy rising, pitch lifting at the end

lines.text: Nobody was listening.
lines.style: short and quiet, a little rueful, let it land, no falling sigh

lines.text: Quick note. Hivewise is made up, and so is, uh, every number here.
lines.style: light and quick aside, a half smile, a tiny stumble on 'every number'

lines.text: The dots still work like a real deck.
lines.style: brisk and helpful, upbeat

lines.text: Solid is measured, half is inferred, dashed is a guess.
lines.style: crisp list, three even steps, each one a little higher, ending lifted

lines.text: Last winter our pilot beekeepers lost thirty-eight percent of their colonies.
lines.style: serious and lower, weight on 'thirty-eight percent', controlled

lines.text: Varroa mites. A failed queen. A cold snap.
lines.style: quick rapid list, three short beats, a little incredulous

lines.text: And most of those losses were found in spring.
lines.style: building, slower, setting it up

lines.text: Too late to do anything.
lines.style: short and blunt, stress on 'too late', firm not sad, slight lift at the end

lines.text: Here is the insight.
lines.style: energy back up, eager, like sharing a secret you love

lines.text: A healthy colony hums. Steady, low, almost, almost boring.
lines.style: calm and smooth, a smile on 'boring', a small playful repeat

lines.text: A queenless colony roars.
lines.style: a jolt of energy, stress on 'roars', bigger

lines.text: The pitch climbs, and it gets ragged.
lines.style: quick and vivid, rising through the line

lines.text: We hear that change about three weeks before a beekeeper would see it.
lines.style: the key claim, slower and certain, every word placed, lifting on 'three weeks'

lines.text: That number is inferred, from forty hives.
lines.style: honest and quick, lower, a straight aside

lines.text: So we built the ear.
lines.style: confident and proud, short, a grin in the voice

lines.text: A small sensor sits under the lid and listens all day.
lines.style: warm and clear, easy pace

lines.text: A tiny model on the device scores the sound...
lines.style: quicker, a little techie excitement

lines.text: so it runs for a year on one battery.
lines.style: pleased, stress on 'a year', bright lift

lines.text: When something changes, your phone tells you which hive, and what to check.
lines.style: reassuring and direct, talking to one beekeeper, ending open and lifted

lines.text: We started in January with forty hives.
lines.style: brisk, matter-of-fact, setting a baseline

lines.text: Today it's one thousand two hundred and forty. All through word of mouth.
lines.style: rising pride, stress on the number, quick and bright on 'word of mouth'

lines.text: The dashed line is our guess for December. Six thousand hives.
lines.style: candid, slightly lower, a beat before 'six thousand'

lines.text: It's a guess, and I'll, I'll say so every time.
lines.style: honest and warm, a tiny stumble on the repeat, ending lifted

lines.text: The model is simple. Nine dollars a hive, a month.
lines.style: crisp and confident, stress on 'nine dollars', a small smile

lines.text: A hundred and twelve beekeepers pay us today.
lines.style: proud, quick, measured fact

lines.text: We think the margin is about seventy-one percent.
lines.style: careful, even, a touch lower

lines.text: Payback in five months is, um, still a guess.
lines.style: candid and light, a small search before 'still a guess'

lines.text: So here is the ask.
lines.style: lean in, quieter, a nervous energy held in check

lines.text: We're raising one point two million dollars.
lines.style: strong and clear, the headline number, no hesitation

lines.text: Almost half goes into sensors, a third into the team, the rest into sales.
lines.style: quick and organized, counting it off, rising

lines.text: That buys eighteen months, and ten thousand hives listening.
lines.style: big finish, energized and believing, lifting on 'ten thousand hives'

lines.text: Thank you. I'd love your questions.
lines.style: warm and relaxed, smiling, open and inviting
